checkpoint.matchedOn: same pre-move position, discarded pips, remaining hand size, count K of playable unknown stones; not identical playable identities or branch geometry
checkpoint.interpretation: Fresh min-hand-pips discovery; differences are conditional on selected first eligible pairs, not causal effects of preserving doubles or reducing next-player options. Subgroups exploratory and possibly underpowered.
checkpoint.confidence: position-cluster normal intervals exploratory; uniform hidden worlds sampled with replacement; policy and first eligible selection bias; assumed opening/branch rules; no opponent-history posterior; block winner unassigned; Node CLI not executed
checkpoint.next: On disjoint seeds 4000000..4099999 replicate K/overlap subgroup effects with quotas >=20 each; record actual first-opponent reply/pass and four-end post-action geometry, then test whether overlap strata predict finish advantage across bot policies.

data.selection: first eligible state and lexicographically first single-vs-one-double pair per deal; turns 4..24, no earlier pass; equal discarded pips, remaining hand size, and distinct playable unknown stone count K
data.limitations: Matched K is not matched tile identities or branch geometry. Uniform hidden allocations with replacement and no opponent-history conditioning; deterministic bots, assumed double opening, no block winner; post-action mobility is descriptive mediator, not causal adjustment. Position-level exploratory normal intervals are not pre-registered.
data.next: Repeat on disjoint seeds, require >=20 positions per K/overlap subgroup, then compare first-opponent reply identity and later finish while matching full four-end geometry where possible.

analysis.method: equal-weight per position; exploratory position-level normal intervals; strata descriptive, not causal; K=distinct playable unknown tiles after each candidate; overlap=shared playable tile identities
